title: Move toward a target
prompt: Move the robot's x toward target at speed, but never past it. Return the new x. From 9 toward 10 at 4 per second, a 0.5 s frame lands exactly on 10, not 11.
signature: func solve(x, target, speed, delta) -> float:
starter:
func solve(x, target, speed, delta) -> float:
	return x + speed * delta
hints: Godot has a built-in that moves a value toward another by a limited step.
The step is how far you may go this frame: speed times delta.

docs.name: move_toward(from, to, step)
docs.what: Returns from moved toward to by at most step, never past it.

solution:
func solve(x, target, speed, delta) -> float:
	return move_toward(x, target, speed * delta)
